$description: SpeakUp design tokens. Dark-first. Sizes in sp/dp (Android) = pt (iOS) = px at 1x (web). Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x, computed in design/brand/brand-guide.html.

night.use: Page background (dark). Ink on Signal Yellow, Coral and Cyan.

duskLine.use: Decorative dividers only. Under 3:1 on Night, so never the only boundary of a control; use `outline` for that.

signalYellow.use: Primary brand colour, the mark, primary buttons, focus rings.

paper.use: Body text on dark. Page background in light mode.

voiceCoral.use: Speaking state, warnings. Large text or icons on dark; not body text on Dusk.

light.$note: Yellow, Coral and Cyan fail as text on Paper. In light mode they appear only as fills behind Night text.

state.$note: Every state is also spoken and shown as a word. Colour is never the only signal.

idle.label: Ready
idle.ribbon: flat line, slow 4s breathe at 30% amplitude

listening.label: Listening
listening.ribbon: follows mic level; waves travel inward (right to left)

thinking.label: Working on it
thinking.ribbon: three soft pulses travelling left to right, 1.2s loop

speaking.label: Speaking
speaking.ribbon: follows speech output level; waves travel outward (left to right)

error.label: Problem
error.ribbon: stops; a single still notch, paired with a spoken explanation and an icon

motion.reducedMotion: Honour the system setting: freeze the ribbon at a still shape in the state colour and keep the label.

scale.$note: Phone body is never below 20sp. All sizes scale with the user's font-size setting; layouts must reflow up to 200%.
